summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A, CEO and CFO certifications, and an earnings press release for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, alongside a Q4 2026 common and preferred dividend press release. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic earnings report by a foreign private issuer, the US-equivalent of a domestic quarterly earnings filing. What to watch: dividend declaration details and any discontinued-operations commentary, not deal terms.
